reason: Admit the unchanged candidate to the once-frozen research confirmation and long groups. The 1797s scope-verified N2 prefix has material U and gap improvement over ENS (signed deltas -0.01755001901983108 and -0.01750303882261664), though it still loses to principal benchmark P. C2 improves ENS at earlier shared checkpoints but regresses at 1797s; C3 retains a large P advantage while its U is worse than ENS; F2 certifies ahead of censored P but is materially slower than certified ENS and J. These mixed complete results leave a real incremental budget benefit to confirm and do not fully negate this implementation. Admission does not imply adoption, stable performance, hull-wide weakness or a pure-cut causal estimate. All losses remain in the final decision.
